source_games: 96 seeded uniform-play normal-start games; snapshots at ply%17==3
targets: One-ply legal recapture after candidate MOVE. Local-only: all replies adjacent. Far-only: every recapture is a cannon jump of Manhattan distance >=3. Opened: far-only where vacated source was on cannon ray. Negative: no legal recapture.
probe: B checkpoints separately; train-only zscore; class-balanced ridge least squares lambda .01; fixed geometry baseline, then frozen endpoints+geometry, then context, then spatial cells along four target-relative rays. Compare within same state & capture/quiet class to safe actions; policy prefers safe, probe identifies exposure. No PPO weight changes.
scope: post-hoc tactical diagnostic, not an official strength benchmark
